options.62878: Polybutylene (PB) piping was used extensively from 1978 to 1995. Major problems with this piping were reported and numerous class-action suits resulted. The problems arise because the plastic fittings used with PB piping allegedly corrode when they come in contact with the chlorine in tap water. This problem can often be remedied by replacing the cemented plastic fittings with compression fittings. Newer installations that employ copper or brass fittings and manifold systems can be reliable. Describe location and extent of PB piping and if there is a history of leaks…..
options.62879: Acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene (ABS) pipe is rigid black plastic pipe used to drain sinks, tubs, showers, toilets, washing machines and dishwashers. Six class action complaints allege that ABS pipe manufactured at certain times between 1984 and 1990 by Polaris Pipe Co. ("Polaris"), Gable Plastics, Inc. ("Gable"), Centaur Mfg., Inc. ("Centaur"), Centaur Marketing, Inc. a/k/a Phoenix Extrusion Co. ("Phoenix"), and Apache Plastics, Inc. ("Apache") is defective and may leak. The overwhelming majority of the allegedly defective ABS pipe at issue is in the State of California. Describe location and extent of ABS piping and if there is a history of leaks…..
options.62880: Galvanized pipe is defined as “a steel pipe or wrought-iron pipe, of standard dimensions, which has been galvanized by coating it with a thin layer of zinc.” Galvanized piping has been utilized as a water supply system throughout the country and is not limited to certain dates of construction. Galvanized piping systems typically exhibit corrosion more quickly than other plumbing systems. It oxidizes from the inside out, the oxidation (rust) reduces the interior diameter of the pipe, restricting the flow of water and usually first leaks at threaded joints where the pipes are joined. Galvanized pipe corrodes more quickly when it comes in direct contact with copper; dielectric couplers are special connectors to prevent galvanic action or electrolysis. Describe location and extent of ABS piping and if there is a history of leaks…..

Heating is provided by two 560 horsepower, 24,056 MBH Johnston steam boilers. options.121137: Federal Pacific Electric (FPE) Stab-Lok circuit breaker panels have been identified as a potential fire hazard as the breakers may not trip in an overload or short circuit situation.  FPE ceased manufacturing this equipment in the mid 1980s, however, FPE Stab-Lok circuit breakers were widely used in multi-family and commercial properties constructed from the 1950s through the 1980s.
